summary: Two people, the reasons they cannot be together, the pull that wins anyway, the break, and the change that brings them back. The relationship is the plot.
bestFor: a love story inside another genre
_lineage: A common romance structure; romance-craft books (for example a four-phase beat sheet by Gwen Hayes) teach similar arcs. The beat names and descriptions here are our own; _commonNames records genre-wide terms, for recognition only.

beats.name: Two lives apart
beats.describe: Each lead's life, and the wound or the want that makes love a risk for them.
lookFor: each lead alone, with a reason not to need anyone

beats.name: The meeting
beats.describe: The leads meet. The spark is real, and so is the friction.
lookFor: a first scene together with attraction and conflict in it

beats.name: Why it can't work
beats.describe: Each has a reason (a rule, a past, a plan) that rules the other out.
lookFor: a stated reason this person is the wrong person

beats.name: Thrown together
beats.describe: Circumstance keeps them in each other's orbit: a job, a journey, a bargain, a shared enemy.
lookFor: an arrangement that forces time together

beats.name: The growing pull
beats.describe: Attraction and understanding deepen despite the reasons. Each sees the other more truly.

beats.name: Maybe it could work
beats.describe: A moment of real closeness (a kiss, a confession, a night) that changes what is at stake.
lookFor: the first time either admits the feeling

beats.name: Doubt returns
beats.describe: The old wound speaks up. Secrets, fears and outside pressure pull them back toward the reasons.
lookFor: a secret at risk of coming out

beats.name: The retreat
beats.describe: One or both protect themselves and pull away, often choosing the safe old plan.
lookFor: a lead closing a door they had opened

beats.name: The break
beats.describe: It ends, or seems to. The lowest point of the relationship.
lookFor: a parting, a betrayal revealed, words that cannot be taken back

beats.name: Alone with it
beats.describe: Apart, each faces what they were afraid of and what they actually want.
lookFor: a lead seeing their own part in the break

beats.name: The gesture
beats.describe: Someone risks something real to win the other back, proving the change instead of promising it.
lookFor: a public or costly act that answers the reason it couldn't work

beats.name: Together, changed
beats.describe: An ending that shows the two whole and together, for good or for now.
lookFor: the pair in a scene that mirrors the early friction, now easy
